description: Your magic stems from a strange influence on your mind.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.description: Learn additional spells. Cast using psionic energy instead of verbal/somatic components.

features.name: Telepathic
features.description: Telepathy within 60 feet. Creatures you touch can understand you.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.description: Cast psionic spells without somatic components.

features.name: Revelation in Mind
features.description: Read mind of creature you touch. Know its alignment and languages.
